title: Mexican Peso carry cushion thins as USD/MXN breaks 100-day SMA
summary: The Mexican Peso extended its losses for the third straight trading session, down over 0.43% as investors reduce their exposure to the Mexican currency following last week’s Fed decision to raise rates.

title: South Korean Won: Export surge supports BoK stance – Commerzbank
summary: Commerzbank reports South Korea’s exports for the first 20 days of September jumped 78.3% year-on-year, extending nine months of double-digit growth and led by a 259% surge in semiconductor exports.
